terms.gloss: say hello to Marcus for me
evidence: Cic. Att. 4.14.2, cited by L&S: Dionysium jubē salvēre

terms.grammar: salūtem, accusative of salūs, with dīcere and the dative of the person greeted
evidence: Cic. Att. 14.19.6: tū Atticae salūtem dīcēs (Lewis & Short), s.v. salūs
Cic. Fam. 14.7.3: salūtem plūrimam dīcit (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: The opening of a Roman letter, S. D. (salūtem dīcit), and the way to pass on someone’s greetings: Terentia tibi salūtem dīcit.

phrases.english: Say hello to Grandma for me!

sources: Lewis & Short: salveo
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, supplied PDF (printed page numbers): p. 17.
